messages:
maria: Quick sync — marketing wants to announce the release week of Apr 8. Need final changelog link, docs landing URL, and a webinar demo plan by EOD Thu. Who can own final copy and engineering sign-off?
aj: I can own engineering sign-off. Can we aim to freeze codeline for canary by Thu 18:00 PT? Running one more quantization pass now.
sam: I'll own the public-facing title + messaging. Maria, can you share the hero benchmark narrative so I can match the tone?
maria: Sure — short bullets: 2-3x throughput on 8k contexts vs baseline; 40% cost reduction with dynamic batching; stable p95 latency under 150ms on dedicated. Will DM the draft.
trina: Docs side: I can publish the walkthrough and API changelog as soon as I get the final changelog diff. Please include the exact example request/response snippets for `generate` and `stream`.
aj: @trina noted. Two asks from eng: (1) We need a single canonical changelog file (markdown) not multiple diffs; (2) a short EMBED template for the docs showing new fields. I'll attach the snippet once tests pass.
maria: Webinar planning: propose Apr 9 10am PT (recorded). Need a 20min demo + 15min Q+A. Who has a demo script?
sam: I can draft the demo script. Suggest focusing on routing fallback, cost/latency dashboard, and a quick code sample for private deploy.
aj: Quick ops update: canary pipeline ran at Tue 02:13Z, deploy-bot reports one failing test (quantized-kernel). I'm re-running with different kernel tuning. If green by Thu EOD, we can tag.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: canary-us-west | pipeline-id=ci-2245 | status=running
maria: If canary hits green by Thu, marketing will lock copy Fri morning and schedule the post + webinar invite. Please confirm changelog link by Thu 12:00 PT so docs can stage.
aj: Aiming for Thu 11:00 PT for changelog.md — will push to `release/2245` and ping here.
trina: Once changelog is in `release/2245/changelog.md` I'll create the docs PR and include the example payloads. ETA Fri 09:00 PT for docs review.
maria: Great. One more thing — inbound leads: please include the webinar RSVP link and a UTM for the launch email. I'll share tracking params after copy lock.
sam: I'll coordinate the demo hosts and collect a short slide deck. If we need a backup talk track in case of regressions, I'll prepare a prerecorded clip of the dashboard.
aj: Will update this thread when the kernel test finishes. If we see flakiness, prefer delaying announcement by 24 hours rather than pushing a partial rollback.
maria: Thanks all — feel free to add any TODOs inline. I'll track actions in the launch doc and ping again once we have changelog URL. :pray:
